news.headline: Perimeter Announces Preliminary Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue was $503,000 (100% recurring), up 31% sequentially from Q1; net loss narrowed 33% year-over-year to $2.6 million as opex fell to $3.1 million from $4.3 million. Cash stood at $6.4 million at June 30, 2026, with management framing the quarter as the pivot from legacy S-Series sales to launching the FDA PMA-approved, AI-enabled Claire OCT device.

news.headline: Intermountain Health Brings Perimeter's Claire to the Operating Room, a Landmark in Breast Cancer Surgery Using AI
news.summary: Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to commercially deploy Perimeter's Claire OCT System, installing it in operating rooms at LDS Hospital (Salt Lake City) and American Fork Hospital, Utah, under the pair's existing systemwide agreement -- the first real-world commercial placement of the newly FDA-approved device.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Following the Aug 20 Q2 release cadence, Perimeter's next quarterly report should show early traction of Claire commercial placements beyond the initial Intermountain Health deployment; exact date not yet scheduled.

catalysts.label: Expansion of Claire within Intermountain Health system
catalysts.detail: The systemwide agreement with Intermountain Health allows any of its hospitals to acquire Claire; additional site go-lives beyond LDS Hospital and American Fork would be a visible proof point of commercial scaling.

catalysts.label: Conversion of ~50-hospital sales funnel
catalysts.detail: Management has cited roughly 50 hospital leads in its sales pipeline for Claire; new commercial placements/legacy S-Series replacements are the key volume driver watched by investors.

catalysts.label: Possible U.S. redomiciling / Nasdaq uplisting
catalysts.detail: Investor commentary has flagged a potential move of corporate domicile from British Columbia to the U.S. as a step that could clear the way for a future Nasdaq uplisting and re-rating; this has not been formally announced by the company as a completed or imminent event.

pulse: Perimeter is mid-pivot from its legacy S-Series OCT business to commercializing the FDA PMA-approved, AI-enabled Claire OCT platform, evidenced by Q2 2026 recurring revenue of $503K (+31% QoQ) and a narrowing net loss ($2.6M, cash $6.4M) alongside the first real-world commercial Claire deployment at Intermountain Health (Aug 13, 2026). The stock remains a thinly-traded, cash-constrained microcap where the pace of converting its ~50-hospital sales pipeline into Claire placements is the central near-term catalyst investors are watching.
